status_note: Proposed before implementation for #159/#313 to accept or amend. Not reviewer-accepted (R2) yet; see docs/testing/first-launch.md.

frame.row_order: top row first, left to right

A.how: guest-selected constant-colour pixel pipeline covering the frame; shader constants are 255/255, 128/255, 0/255, 255/255

B.how: guest-written 4x3 RGBA8 texture, sampled by a guest-selected textured pipeline with nearest filtering and clamp-to-edge over a full-frame quad, so pixel (x, y) samples texel (x, y) at its centre

guest_exit.status_note: ASCII 'LNCH' as a big-endian u32; any other status is a failure

restart: after a clean close, a second session in the same app process repeats frames 0-59 from state A with the same pixels and exit status; nothing carries over

negative_controls.name: no_metal
negative_controls.change: no Metal device or no BC/compute capability needed by the fixture
negative_controls.expected: capability unavailable, reported separately from implementation failure; no frame

negative_controls.name: no_frame
negative_controls.change: guest loops without calling frame submit
negative_controls.expected: bounded stop by the worker deadline (#318); classified as no frame

negative_controls.name: unsupported_instruction
negative_controls.change: an instruction the decoder refuses, placed before the first frame
negative_controls.expected: IllegalInstruction exit at that instruction; no frame

negative_controls.name: bad_shader_or_binding
negative_controls.change: an unsupported shader form or an empty binding slot
negative_controls.expected: rejected when the object is created or bound; that draw never reaches Metal

negative_controls.name: wrong_expected_pixel
negative_controls.change: one channel of one expected pixel changed in a copy of this file
negative_controls.expected: mismatch reported with session, frame, x, y and channel

negative_controls.name: low_step_budget
negative_controls.change: a budget that ends before the guest's exit

negative_controls.name: worker_timeout
negative_controls.change: a wall deadline shorter than the run
negative_controls.expected: timeout classification with the last completed stage
